title: dlfeval
summary: Evaluate a function handle in Deep Learning compatibility context.
description: `dlfeval(fun,args...)` invokes a function handle through RunMat's function-handle dispatch and forwards requested outputs.
behaviors: `fun` must be a function handle value, including named handles, method handles, bound handles, and closures.
Requested output count is preserved, so bracketed multi-output calls forward to the invoked function.
Automatic differentiation tracing and `dlgradient`-style gradient recording are not implemented in this slice.
Text function names and callable objects are rejected by `dlfeval`; use `feval` for those RunMat extension forms.

examples.output: Outputs returned by `modelLoss`; automatic differentiation remains future work.

gpu_residency: `dlfeval` preserves callable dispatch behavior; provider-resident autodiff and gradient tracing remain future work.
